_comment: Copy this to rules.json and adjust screener names to match your TradingView saved screens.
risk_rules: Never risk more than 1% of total account on a single trade
No trading in the first 15 minutes of the NYSE open (9:30-9:45 AM ET)
Maximum 5 open positions across all instrument types at once
If 3 consecutive losing trades in a day, stop trading for the day
notes: Symbols are sourced live from TradingView screeners — no hardcoded watchlists.
Each instrument type has its own strategy-{type}.json with bias criteria, entry/exit rules, and risk rules.
Screener names must exactly match the saved screen names in your TradingView account.
Screener must appear in 'Recently used' for screener_get to find it by name — open each screen at least once.
